name: Improved Stamp
body:
You have improved your ability to fight using your hooves.

Prerequisites: Lapith, Str 13, BAB +1, Stamp.

Benefit: The base damage of your natural hoof attack increases. You can either make two natural secondary attacks with a base damage of 1d6, or a single natural secondary attack with a base damage of 1d8.
